_doc: Registry classification for acquisitions whose manifest.json / processing.json does not state theme, data class or suitability (docs/urbanos/INFRASTRUCTURE_DATA.md §1). Applied by `python -m datasets.importer` at registration, and to already-registered versions whose class/suitability is still NULL (fill-only: a value a manifest states is never replaced; versions stay immutable otherwise). Raw files are never edited. Keys are dataset ids (= the directory name under raw/ or derived/). Every entry carries its reason. `correct_stated_class` {from, to, reason} is the one exception to fill-only: it replaces a manifest-STATED class word equal to `from` at registration; for an already-registered version the corrected metadata registers as a new version (pending review), never an edit. Written 2026-11-13 IST by the infra/coordination agent from each directory's own processing.json / manifest notes.

bhuvan_ogc_capabilities.reason: OGC GetCapabilities documents as retrieved: service metadata, not geodata; nothing in it can support a screening decision.

bhuvan_wms_samples.reason: Rendered WMS map images (styled pictures of ISRO/NRSC layers), not the underlying data; picture only.

chirps_v2_climateserv.reason: Manifest: CHIRPS v2 blends satellite IR with station data (model estimate); ~5 km cells: screening only.

copernicus_dem_glo30.reason: Manifest: observed DSM (radar surface incl. buildings/trees), not bare earth; no stated vertical accuracy for Pune: screening.

cpcb_caaqms_station_list.reason: Station list as published by CPCB (locations/metadata of measuring stations).

datameet_municipal_wards.reason: Manifest: community-traced ward boundaries (inferred from maps); not the official boundary file: display only.

esa_worldcover_2021_v200.reason: Manifest: classifier output on Sentinel-1/2 2021 (10 m).

google_open_buildings_v3.reason: ML footprint detections (Google Open Buildings v3, confidence per polygon). A manifest-stated class takes precedence (fill-only).

correct_stated_class.reason: Google Open Buildings v3: footprints are machine-learning detections from imagery (the manifest itself says 'ML detections'). UrbanOS vocabulary: an ML prediction of an object's presence is 'inferred'; 'derived' is a deterministic transform of observed data. Same files; corrected 2026-11-13 by QA.

imd_gridded_rainfall_025.reason: IMD 0.25° gridded analysis interpolated from the rain-gauge network (~27 km cell): estimate, screening only.

ms_global_ml_buildings.reason: ML footprint detections from Bing imagery (no per-polygon confidence; height -1 = UNKNOWN). A manifest-stated class takes precedence (fill-only).

correct_stated_class.reason: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints: footprints are machine-learning detections from imagery (the manifest itself says 'ML detections'). UrbanOS vocabulary: an ML prediction of an object's presence is 'inferred'; 'derived' is a deterministic transform of observed data. Same files; corrected 2026-11-13 by QA.

nasadem_pc.reason: Manifest: SRTM C-band surface model (Feb 2000), DSM not bare earth.

nwdp_india_wris.reason: Manual depth-to-water readings at CGWB/GSDA wells as published on NWDP (India-WRIS).

nwdp_meta.reason: NWDP catalogue/metadata responses as retrieved, not measurements.

opencity_pune.reason: Bundle of 96 files mirrored by OpenCity from PMC/PMPML/CPCB etc., as published. Each layer used by UrbanOS is classified on its own derived dataset (pmc_*, pmpml_*). Licence conflict recorded (catalogue/india.md): treat as non-commercial, credit OpenCity + original publisher.

pmc_autodcr_geoserver_probe.reason: Capabilities probe of the PMC AutoDCR GeoServer (metadata only; layers not downloaded — permission requested, MISSING_DATA_AND_COLLECTION_PLAN).

pmc_opendata_portal_catalogue.reason: Catalogue listing of the PMC open-data portal (metadata only).

sentinel2_l2a_earthsearch.reason: Manifest: ESA L2A surface reflectance (windowed extracts).

soilgrids_250m_v2.reason: Manifest: Quantile Random Forest predictions at 250 m; urban areas masked; never for foundation design.

buildings_comparison.reason: Merged OSM + Microsoft + Google footprints with per-feature source and OSM-agreement status (comparison layer).

cpcb_caaqms_pune.reason: processing.json: observed concentrations as published (CPCB via OpenCity), no interpolation.

elevation_copdem30.reason: Clipped/reprojected Copernicus DSM and hydrology derivatives (DSM, not bare earth).

imd_district_rainfall_pune.reason: District-average daily rainfall computed by IMD from gauges (aggregate of observations); licence field empty → UNKNOWN.

imd_rainfall_025_pune.reason: processing.json: IMD gridded analysis, ~27 km cells: interpolated estimate, screening only.

nwdp_groundwater_pune.reason: processing.json: observed manual depth-to-water (m bgl), not interpolated.

pmc_admin_wards_2017.reason: PMC administrative ward polygons as published (survey method/accuracy UNKNOWN).

pmc_electoral_wards_2012.reason: PMC electoral wards 2012 as published; historical version (superseded by 2017/2022/2025).

pmc_electoral_wards_2017.reason: PMC electoral wards 2017 as published; historical version.

pmc_electoral_wards_2022.reason: PMC electoral wards 2022 as published; historical version (2022 delimitation; not used for the 2026 elections as far as recorded).

pmc_electoral_wards_2025.reason: PMC electoral wards 2025 as published — the latest version, shown as active in Explore.

pmc_prabhag_boundary.reason: PMC prabhag polygons as published (vintage not stated by the publisher).

pmc_revenue_map.reason: Revenue map (gut numbers, villages, TP schemes) as published by PMC. Not a legal cadastral record: boundaries for screening only.

pmc_road_centerline.reason: PMC road centrelines as published (width/RoW not included).

pmc_sewage_pipelines.reason: PMC sewer records as published (44,482 pipes). Records-based position = ASCE 38 QL-D when used in coordination; invert and top levels are DESIGN values, unverified by survey.

pmc_stormwater_drains.reason: PMC storm-water layer as published (141,341 lines). Only the 9,187 rows labelled category 'Storm water drains' are storm drains; the rest are sewer / nalla rows (rule in INFRASTRUCTURE_DATA.md §3). No levels on the storm-drain rows.

pmc_swd_chambers.reason: PMC storm-water chamber points as published.

pmc_swd_utility_chambers.reason: PMC SWD utility chamber points as published.

pmc_rivers.reason: PMC river polygons as published (not flood lines).

pmc_stps.reason: PMC STP polygons as published — includes PROPOSED plants (see attributes); not all exist.

pmc_tree_census_2019.reason: processing.json: PMC tree census 2019 vintage, observed.

pmc_tree_census_2019_index.reason: Spatial index built from the 2019 tree census (no new values).

pmc_crematoriums.reason: PMC crematorium / burial-ground polygons as published.

pmc_parks_gardens.reason: PMC parks and gardens polygons as published.

pmpml_bus_stops.reason: PMPML stop points (GTFS-style stops) as published.

water_bodies_census_pune_2023.reason: Water bodies census 2023 points as published (MoJS census via OpenCity; licence 'Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any)').

surface_water_jrc_gsw.reason: JRC GSW occurrence clipped to Pune.

infra_index.reason: Spatial index (SQLite R*Tree) of the municipal layers and the merged buildings layer; per-layer class is carried on each layer.

census2011_pune_wards.reason: Census of India 2011 ward table for PMC (144 census wards) via OpenCity; historical (2011). Not mappable: no 2011 census-ward boundary file.
